title: Unique check-in point at Gieng Troi Da Nang

html:
Located in Ba Na – Nui Chua conservation area, but the road to Gieng Troi is quite difficult and arduous, but in return, this place brings a wild beauty, with clear blue water in the middle of the forest, a camping spot sought after by many backpackers.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang, visit Ba Na scenic area, visit Gieng Troi, a wild landscape, a destination for tourists who love nature, especially those who enjoy outdoor activities such as trekking, mountain climbing, camping or bathing in streams.

To reach Gieng Troi from Ba Na parking lot, visitors will conquer 7km of winding steep mountain passes, cross the stream through the forest, through the slopes, visitors will encounter a cool green stream pouring down from above, looking beautiful like a love story in the middle of the mountains and forests.

If you travel to Da Nang in the summer, you can not only immerse yourself in the clear blue water of the sea and islands, but also enjoy camping or sitting by the cool water of the Da Nang Sky Well, the most beautiful place to hide from the sun on weekends.

Sky Well is the meeting place of two streams from the western area of ​​Ba Na, forming an alley and creating a canyon from above, overlapping like a love song between the mountains and forests.

The waterfall from above pours down at night, creating white foam, visitors coming here can sit on a rock to check in for themselves a beautiful picture next to the cool blue water.

The water flows down to form a large stream, creating a beautiful picture that captivates travelers. When the hot summer weather comes to Sky Well, visitors will immerse themselves in the cool water, as if to dispel all the worries of life in the bustling city.

So it can be said that when coming to Gieng Troi, visitors will feel the pristine beauty, and record for themselves beautiful pictures with the beautiful natural scenery, especially when sitting on the rock with feet in the cool water, a beautiful scene.
